== Exact published English Set 11 text ==
The remaster removes immunity to Mon Mothma. Both slips keep the Reflections III Objective restriction and corresponding duel and Mara terms. The Gold design credit prints 2005, while the later slip prints 2004. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16604#page=2 Players Committee original sheet, p. 2, slip 17].
